questions.title: Sarafand — the camp or the village?
questions.question: Your sheet marks Sarafand 'check specifically: can refer to the camp or the village'. Seven Muslim and three Christian patients. Which Sarafand — the British camp at Sarafand al-Amar, either Ramle village, or Sarafand in Lebanon?

questions.title: Jisr el-Majami — village, station or bridge?
questions.question: You marked it 'village and station' and gave the bridge's Wikidata item (Q20384748). Several records are police or IPC postings there. One place, or should the station/police post be kept apart from the village?

questions.title: Beit Gan — your Q2900552, marked 'check'
questions.question: You identified Beit Gan (by Yavne'el, Q2900552) but marked it to check. Is that the settlement these patients came from?
questions.reading: On the map at your Q2900552 (Sinai confirmed it, 24 Oct 2026, and added two 'Bet Jan' records from 1937); Beit Gan has no Kima entry (a donation candidate).

questions.title: Jabata — which village?
questions.question: You read 'Jabata' as Jebata and marked it to check. Is this Jibta, or another village?

questions.title: Raman — Rameh?
questions.question: You read Raman as Rameh, with 'check'. Our standing ruling is that Rameh is al-Rama in the Galilee, not Ramleh. Same here?

questions.title: Tel Shamman — Tel Amal (Nir David)?
questions.question: You read it as Tel Amal, with 'check'. Tel Amal was founded 1936 and became Nir David. Is that right for this record?

questions.title: Tabor — Kfar Tavor, or Mount Tabor?
questions.question: You read 'Tabor' as Kfar Tavor, with 'check'. Two further records say 'Mount Tabor' / 'Mt. Tabor' (Kadoorie school is there). Village or mountain?

questions.title: Beit Lahim — Bat Galim, or Bethlehem of Galilee?
questions.question: Your sheet: 'Bat Galim or Beit Lehem?', check. Two more records say 'Bethlehem'. We lean to Bethlehem of Galilee (the German Templer colony) for those. And Beit Lahim?

questions.title: Kibbutz Hashomer (Hatzair) — a Haifa group?
questions.question: You typed it as a Haifa neighbourhood (and 'Hedera Kibutz' with check). Was this the Hashomer Hatzair urban group in Haifa, or a kibbutz elsewhere (Hadera)?

questions.title: Hadar — Hadera, or Hadar HaCarmel?
questions.question: You read 'Hadar' as Hedera, with 'check'. These four records say 'Retsof street Hadar', 'Hadar Police Billet', 'Beit Dr … Hadar'. We read them as Hadar HaCarmel. Agree?

questions.title: Kineret — the moshava or the kvutza?
questions.question: Kinneret (moshava, 1909) and Kvutzat Kinneret (1913) are a kilometre apart. Is there any way to tell them apart in these records?
questions.reading: Sinai's ruling (24 Oct 2026): a bare Kinneret is the moshava (Q2891213); the 9 records whose address says kibbutz / kvutza (or Hashomer Hatzair) go to the kvutza. No record names the moshava outright: tell us if you know otherwise.

questions.title: Zarka
questions.question: Jisr al-Zarqa, or another Zarqa?

questions.title: Jdeideh / Gdeideh
questions.question: al-Judayda by Acre (Jdeideh-Makr), or another Judayda?

questions.title: Kurdaneh — Kurdani by Na'aman spring?
questions.question: Kurdani has no Kima entry. Is it the Kurdani by the Na'aman spring, near Acre?

questions.title: Arab el-Turkman
questions.question: Which Turkman group or encampment (Marj ibn Amer / Megiddo area)?

questions.title: Nahlat Yacob
questions.question: Nahalat Ya'akov — where? (Not to be confused with Nahalat Yehuda, which the scans showed is a third toponym near Ard el-Yahud.)

questions.group: 3 · Where your sheet and the records part ways
questions.title: Rihanieh — Haifa sub-district or Safad?
questions.question: You identified 'Rihanieh' as al-Rihaniyya in the Haifa sub-district (Q2152846). But records spelled 'Rihaniya' read 'Rihanieh. Safad s/o' — the Circassian Rihaniyya in Upper Galilee. Your four Rihanieh records give no district. Are they Haifa's, or Safad's too?
questions.reading: Rihanieh → Haifa's (your ruling); Rihaniya → Safad's (from the address).

questions.group: 3 · Where your sheet and the records part ways
questions.title: Harat al-Yahud and Ard el-Yahud — two places?
questions.question: Your sheet gives the Harat al-Yahud rows the Wikidata item of Ard el-Yahud (Q12404212). Following Naor (2019) we keep them apart: Harat al-Yahud inside the old city, evacuated July 1938; Ard el-Yahud outside the walls, founded 1891. Agree?
questions.reading: Two places; Harat al-Yahud drawn at Haifa.

questions.group: 3 · Where your sheet and the records part ways
questions.title: Kantara — El Qantara East?
questions.question: Your sheet types Kantara as a village without a location. The records are mostly Egyptian railway labourers: 'Kantara East', 'P. Railway Kantara', 'Engineering Kantara'. We read El Qantara East, the Suez Canal end of Palestine Railways. Agree?
questions.reading: El Qantara East (listed beyond the map's edge).

questions.title: Jaba' — the Haifa village
questions.question: Addresses read 'Jaba' Haifa s/o', 'Jaba' Hfa S/Dist.' — so we took Jaba' of the Haifa sub-district (Q4118648), not the Jenin one, for all thirty. Right?

questions.title: Eggim, Eggem, Iggim — Ijzim?
questions.question: Twenty Muslim patients from 'Eggim/Eggem/Iggim'; one reads 'Eggem - Haifa'. We read Ijzim, with g for j. Right?

questions.title: Sileh — Silat al-Harithiya?
questions.question: Addresses read 'Sileh village, Jenin Sub Dist.', 'Near Affuleh', one 'Nablus Sub District'. We took Silat al-Harithiya. Could some be Silat al-Dhahr?

questions.title: Hawassa — the Haifa quarter
questions.question: Twenty-eight Muslim patients from 'Hawassa'. We read Harat al-Hawassa, the shack quarter east of Haifa. Right?

questions.title: Jalameh — al-Jalama of Haifa?
questions.question: 'Haifa District Jalameh', 'Jalameh Police Station'. We took al-Jalama of the Haifa sub-district (Q4704113). Right?

questions.title: Harat al-Mukhallis — a quarter of its own
questions.question: Forty-three Haifa addresses name Mukhallis ('Mukhallis Street', 'Hartel Mukhalis', 'Beit El Mukhalis'). We treat it as its own quarter around Deir al-Mukhallis, not Halisa. Right?

questions.title: Khalsa — the Huleh village; Hallisa — the Haifa quarter
questions.question: Of 151 lines spelled Halisa/Hallissa/Khalisa, 146 are clearly the Haifa quarter. Three, spelled 'Khalsa' (1936–38), we read as al-Khalisa in the Huleh. Right? (And one 'Halleesa, Bureen - Nablus' we left alone.)

questions.title: Mandate villages, not their successors
questions.question: Where Kima's entry is the later settlement, we linked the Mandate village: al-Kabri (not Kibbutz Kabri), Sa'sa' (not Kibbutz Sasa), al-Birwa, al-Tira (not Tirat Carmel), Tarshiha (not Ma'alot). Right?

questions.title: Transjordan — drawn at Salt
questions.question: You placed 'Transjordan' at Salt; we did the same for 'Transj', 'T. Jordan'. A country label on a town's point: keep, or leave off the map?

questions.title: 'Kafr Yashan' — which place?
questions.question: One Polish Jewish patient, August 1937 (NB17 p11, register no. 1708): the address reads 'Kafr yashan'. The extraction matched it to Kafr Yasif, which we doubt for a Polish Jew. Do you recognise it — a Jewish settlement (Kfar Yehoshua? Kfar Hasidim?) or something else?

questions.title: Arrabeh with no district
questions.question: Two Arrabas: Arraba of Jenin and Arrabat al-Battuf. Where the address or the page names a district we split them: 21 Jenin, 13 al-Battuf, and four that the scan shows are Ar'ara. These 24 name neither, on the record or the page — we read the scans. Those that name a district run Jenin in 1934–39 and al-Battuf in 1944–47. Is that a pattern you would trust, or is there another way to tell?

questions.title: Bassa No. 2 — al-Bassa or Shelomi?
questions.question: al-Bassa (Q2915875) and 'Bassa No 2' / Shelomi sit ~1 km apart; the register also has 'Bassa No 1', 'Bassa II. N.F.D.', 'Haifa|Bassa'. Were the numbered Bassas camps? Which records belong to the village?

questions.title: Mountains, valleys, regions
questions.question: Mount Carmel, the Emek, the Huleh, the Galilee, el-Hamme. Should a patient 'from the Emek' go on the map at all, and where?

questions.title: 164 other unidentified spellings (2+ records each)
questions.question: Spellings no round has resolved. Many are misreadings; the scan link beside each record shows what the clerk wrote. Any you recognise, a word is enough.

questions.title: 12 Wikidata conflicts
questions.question: Kima's QID and an independent Wikidata lookup disagree. The independent lookup has been wrong before (Tireh → a village in Iran). Housekeeping for us.
